calls.title: Redis<>GrowthBook - Discussion
calls.summary: Keith Nyberg (Redis, demand gen) and Scott Weaver (engineer) discussed their need to replace Mutiny with a server-side AB testing solution integrated with Sanity and GA4, highlighting pain points around marketer usability and cost. Jake Heier (GrowthBook sales) and Ashley Stirrup (GrowthBook) demoed the open-source platform’s feature flags
